This figure is confirmed by the Death Penalty Information Center (as of March 2025), the National Conference of State Legislatures, and Wikipedia [d1][d2][d7]. In addition to these 27 states, the U.S. federal government and the U.S. military also retain the death penalty [d1][d7].
